rationale: Both are polished dark/amber editorial launches with serif-italic headlines and staggered hero entrances, so the margin is narrow. B's scroll tells a stronger product story: a pinned exploded view of the speaker separates into labelled layers across several frames, followed by a horizontal materials gallery with tactile swatches and a cream feature-card section. A has richer diagrammatic sections (radar and ring visualisations) and a striking metallic HALO footer, plus more varied hover fills, but its hero product arrives later and dimmer, and its mid-page layouts read as more conventional card grids. On mobile both are clean, with no clipping.
